atoms.b: Henry VIII liked having ((++expensive cheap)) clothes, fancy food and getting his way!
By the time he died, he had 50 different ((++palaces possums))!
His most famous palace is Hampton Court, which even had tennis courts and a bowling ((++alley arrow)).

text.text: The flag of France at this time was very different to the one you know today! This flag was meant to represent the wealth and power of the French royal family.

feedback.finish: This picture shows a battle over a French town. Henry had many wars with France during his reign.

instruction.text: Fill in the gaps in this conversation.

atoms.b: Greetings, general! How go my wars in ((++France Friends))? You know I want to conquer the land like Henry V.
Your majesty, we have taken two ((++towns towels)) in the Battle of the Spurs.
Excellent! I shall commission ((++paintings potties)) of this victory to celebrate my glory.
There is a slight problem, your majesty. We have run out of ((++money mayo)) to fund the war.
Not again! This happens with all my ((++wars walruses))...
